summary: Build the three-modality sensorimotor raster for a single zebrafish larva — binarized swim behaviour, the light/dark visual stimulus sequence, and single-neuron ΔF/F₀ calcium traces for four functionally defined ensembles (Motor+, Motor−, Dark, Light) selected as the 50 most extreme neurons by precomputed correlation ranking — all drawn on one shared time axis with per-neuron traces at low alpha and the population…
use_when: Analyze sensorimotor trace panel for one larva
Generate sensorimotor trace panel for one larva outputs
avoid_when: Neural and behavioral measurements cannot be aligned on a common time base
The intended conclusion requires causal inference from an observational association alone
